text:
maria-support: Customer Cobalt Health (acct_cobalt_99) just called — they were charged twice for the March subscription after attaching a PO mid-cycle. Invoices INV-48321 and INV-48322 are both marked PAID. Stripe charges: `ch_1JxAaaaaaaa1` and `ch_1JxBbbbbbbb2`. Can billing take a look and advise next steps?

sophie-cs: Thanks — did they attach the PO before the renewal or after? Any screenshots from the customer?

maria-support: They say they attached the PO after the renewal email, around 03:10 UTC. They attached the PO via the console and then we have a webhook showing PO-linked. I'll forward the screenshot.

ashley-billing: Looking at the account: both invoices were generated ~45s apart. System logs show two invoice_create events: one from the scheduled renewal job, one triggered by the PO-attach flow. Snippet: 
```
2025-06-25T03:09:21Z event=renewal_trigger invoice=INV-48321 job=renewal-scheduler
2025-06-25T03:10:05Z event=po_attach user=acct_cobalt_99 webhook_id=wh_78b invoice=INV-48322
```
Both invoices were auto-settled because the PO-processing flow marks invoices as settled once PO is accepted, and the scheduled job already charged the card.

raj-engineering: This looks like a race between the renewal scheduler and the PO attach handler. The root cause appears to be missing idempotency when a PO is attached during the renewal window — we create a new invoice without checking for a recently-paid invoice for the same period. From the logs: 
```
invoice_create request: {"account":"acct_cobalt_99","period_start":"2025-03-01","period_end":"2025-04-01"} idempotency_key: null
existing_paid_check: false
```
We also saw duplicate webhook deliveries from the PO service around the same time, which made it worse.

maria-support: Ok — customer needs refund for the duplicate. Which invoice should we refund? INV-48322 is the later one (PO-linked).

trevor-finance: We can refund INV-48322 (the PO-linked invoice) in full and create a credit note to record the reversal. Quick actions I will take: 
- initiate Stripe refund for charge `ch_1JxBbbbbbbb2`
- create credit note referencing INV-48322 and link to acct_cobalt_99
- confirm VAT reversal for EU tax registry
Commands I'll run now: 
```
stripe refunds create --charge ch_1JxBbbbbbbb2 --reason duplicate --metadata "support_thread=1743216543"
create_credit_note --invoice INV-48322 --amount_full --reason "duplicate charge due to renewal race"
```
I will also confirm whether the PO should remain attached or re-linked to the existing invoice.

ops-bot: Refund initiated: refund_1KxRefAAA (status: processing) — updated in payments dashboard.

ashley-billing: Note for bookkeeping: mark INV-48322 as void/refunded and keep INV-48321 as the canonical invoice for March. Also check tax reversal flow — VAT was applied on both, so finance should ensure VAT return adjustments are created.

raj-engineering: I'll open a ticket to block this in code. Created INF-1176: "Prevent duplicate invoice creation when PO is attached during renewal window" assigned to eng-runtime. Short-term mitigation: add an atomic check for existing paid/settled invoice within a 10m window before creating a new invoice; also require idempotency_key on invoice_create from the PO workflow. Long-term: move PO attach handler to a transactional step that can upsert instead of blindly creating.

maria-support: Thanks @raj-engineering — can you ETA the patch? Customer asked for the fix so this doesn't happen again.

raj-engineering: Patch PR opened, aiming for canary deploy tomorrow. If tests pass we'll roll to prod in the 48h window.

trevor-finance: Refund went through: refund_1KxRefAAA status: succeeded. Credit note CN-2025-090 created and linked to INV-48322. VAT reversal queued with accounting batch.

sophie-cs: I'll message the customer: apologize, confirm refund and timeline, and note that we're deploying a fix. Template I'll use: 
"Hi — we found a rare race that created two invoices when your PO was attached right at renewal. We've refunded the duplicate (INV-48322) and issued a credit note. You should see the refund on your statement in 3–5 business days. We're also deploying a fix to prevent this going forward. Apologies for the inconvenience."

maria-support: Sent to Cobalt Health and they replied :thumbsup: — they asked for the credit note PDF, Trevor can you attach when ready?

trevor-finance: Credit note PDF attached to the account and emailed.

ashley-billing: Postmortem notes: add monitoring alert for >1 invoice/charge for same account+period within 2m; add idempotency requirement to PO webhook docs; add e2e test for PO attach during renewal.

raj-engineering: Added tests and the idempotency header enforcement. Will follow up in INF-1176 with rollout notes.

maria-support: Closing this thread — refund completed, customer acknowledged, fix routed to eng. Marking resolved.

ops-bot: Thread closed by maria-support at 1743216843
